notes: Only requirements present in claude, deepseek, and llama experiment_runs.jsonl are included.
Only test case optimization requirements are included: test case selection and test case minimization.
Output pass@k is computed from compilation_success, execution_success, and combination_success over each model's repeated runs.
Stage metrics count successful stage runs over the common requirements, e.g., 23/30.
Model summary values are requirement-level macro means over the common requirements.
